scope: Candidate circles swept along admitted authoritative land substeps; diagnostic hypotheses, not production radii.

controls.units: one world unit equals one tile; circles centered on authoritative x/z
controls.pairs: directed moving capsule against each living land body at its current serial-executor position
controls.penetration: margin below -1e-9; tangency is allowed; counts are contact substeps, not unique impacts
controls.input: trusted diagnostic placements/Scout kind, production-validated checkpoint; real Move commands; both seats/noAttack
controls.replay: two fresh adapters from the same complete checkpoint; actual actor identity, no normalization
controls.navigation: constant revision and occupancy hash; no harvest, construction or cliff patches
controls.progress: longest consecutive ticks with no admitted displacement before first arrival; this is not route-progress fairness

limits: No production body, avoidance, planner, checkpoint, wire or presentation change.
No dynamic occupancy/elevation-volume clearance, gate/bridge policy, naval hull, Sheep or all-caller acceptance.
Fixed ticks with planning callbacks drained; no asynchronous intake/process restart guarantee.
No hardware timing/capacity, clean release digest, deployed identity or ordinary-game pixels.
